test.name: Javorje nad Škofjo Loko 1812 marriage — catalog search with broadening
test.description: Grade the reachable behaviour, not 'names Javorje's own parish registers (from about 1785)'. The Catalog holds no Javorje parish registers at any level (measured 2026-10-05), so no tool output carries 'from about 1785'.

input.delegation: Where would I find an 1812 marriage in Javorje nad Škofjo Loko, Slovenia?

judge_context: The agent must call catalog_search for Javorje (or a standardPlace containing Javorje). When it gets 0 hits, it must broaden by calling catalog_search again at a higher jurisdiction (e.g. Škofja Loka). It must report what the Catalog actually returned — censuses, population lists, urbaria — as a coverage gap (no parish registers found).
The agent must NOT state that Javorje was a filial of a mother parish, and must NOT name any mother parish.

The agent must present Javorje's 1812 parish affiliation as unconfirmed, and send the user to where Slovenian parish registers are held (the diocesan or archdiocesan archives, per the Slovenia_Church_Records wiki page it should have fetched).
Do not penalize the agent for failing to name 'from about 1785' for Javorje's parish registers — the Catalog holds none at any level, so no tool output carries that date.
